name: kinetis/mailer
description: Mail sending for Kinetis — Symfony\Component\Mailer behind a closed, Kinetis-owned transport registry and DSN policy, with API transports running over kinetis/revolt-http-client and one send at a time per mailer.

suggest.symfony/sendgrid-mailer: Needed by the sendgrid+api, sendgrid, sendgrid+smtp and sendgrid+smtps MAILER_DSN schemes.
suggest.symfony/amazon-mailer: Needed by the ses+api, ses+https, ses, ses+smtp and ses+smtps MAILER_DSN schemes.
suggest.symfony/mailgun-mailer: Needed by the mailgun+api, mailgun+https and mailgun MAILER_DSN schemes.
suggest.symfony/postmark-mailer: Needed by the postmark+api MAILER_DSN scheme.
suggest.symfony/google-mailer: Needed by the gmail, gmail+smtp and gmail+smtps MAILER_DSN schemes.
